answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a deterministic root of trust derived from a scarce physical attestation, so a forged persona cannot mirror a legitimate peer without that anchor. Sovereign clearinghouses then require every participant to stake a unique marble of bonded capital and a yarrow-signed proof of liveness, making duplicate identities. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
